originalTitle: Trump unveils 'Super Intelligence Force' to oversee AI policy
summary: The president named his national intelligence chief will head the taskforce as worries over the technology grow.
content:
US President Donald Trump says he has created a new task force focused on artificial intelligence, which will be led by Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton.

The "Super Intelligence Force" will work to ensure that the US continues to lead in the technology's development and will coordinate the government's engagement with the public, Trump posted on Sunday.

Federal Trade Commission Chair Andrew Ferguson and Undersecretary of Defense for Research and Engineering Emil Michael will also be part of the task force.

Trump said last week that he would set up a board to oversee AI safety after top tech bosses signed what he described as a "morally binding" pact to regulate the technology.

"The Super Intelligence Force will coordinate the Federal Government's engagement with Consumers, Public Interest Groups, Religious Organizations, Critical Infrastructure Providers, and Super Intelligence Companies," Trump wrote.

The taskforce's announcement follows growing pressure from prominent figures in the industry to tighten regulation of the technology.

Trump has dismissed calls for stronger oversight and largely left it to AI companies to regulate themselves.

The pact signed on 29 September includes the signatures of executives from top tech firms like OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceX and Google.

US Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton

On the same day, the president also signed an executive order to rename AI as "super intelligence", after previously saying the word artificial made the technology sound "fake".

Some experts have questioned the logic of the rebranding , arguing that the use of "super intelligence" could cause confusion as it refers to more advanced systems.

Some top tech leaders have already started to use the new name, including multi-billionaire Elon Musk, who said on social media on Sunday that he will rename his firm's AI platform SpaceXAI as SpaceXSI.

"SpaceX is a super intelligence company", Musk wrote.

The Tesla boss has recently been brought back into the US government to be part of a project to study the future of war.

Musk previously served in the Trump administration, heading the so-called Department of Government Efficiency, before his tenure ended in a public spat with Trump .

chineseTitle: 特朗普推出“超级情报部队”来监督 AI 政策
chineseSummary: 随着对这项技术的担忧日益加剧，总统任命国家情报总监将领导该工作组。
chineseContent:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，他已经成立了一个专注于人工智能的新工作组，该工作组将由国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿领导。

特朗普周日表示，“超级情报部队”将努力确保美国继续在技术开发方面处于领先地位，并将协调政府与公众的接触。

联邦贸易委员会主席安德鲁·弗格森和负责研究与工程的国防部副部长埃米尔·迈克尔也将成为该工作组的成员。

特朗普上周表示，在顶级科技巨头签署了他所称的“具有道德约束力”的技术监管协议后，他将成立一个委员会来监督人工智能安全。

特朗普写道：“超级情报部队将协调联邦政府与消费者、公共利益团体、宗教组织、关键基础设施提供商和超级情报公司的接触。”

在该工作组宣布这一消息之前，业内知名人士要求加强对该技术的监管的压力越来越大。

特朗普驳回了加强监管的呼吁，并在很大程度上让人工智能公司自行监管。

9 月 29 日签署的协议包括来自 OpenAI、Anthropic、SpaceX 和 Google 等顶级科技公司高管的签名。

美国国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿

同一天，总统还签署了一项行政命令，将人工智能重新命名为“超级智能”，此前他曾表示“人工”一词让这项技术听起来“假”。

一些专家质疑品牌重塑的逻辑，认为“超级智能”的使用可能会引起混乱，因为它指的是更先进的系统。

一些顶级科技领袖已经开始使用这个新名称，其中包括亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克，他周日在社交媒体上表示，他将把公司的人工智能平台 SpaceXAI 更名为 SpaceXSI。

“SpaceX 是一家超级情报公司”，马斯克写道。

这位特斯拉老板最近被带回美国政府，参与研究战争未来的项目。

马斯克此前曾在特朗普政府任职，领导所谓的政府效率部，但他的任期因与特朗普的公开争吵而结束。
